name: readback
description: Read every number in an AI answer back against its source: matched, derived, or no match, with the reason for each.

scripts.parity: node test/parity.mjs ../vehicle-intelligence/site/replay.json /tmp/readback-js.json && python3 test/parity_py.py ../vehicle-intelligence/eval ../vehicle-intelligence/site/replay.json /tmp/readback-py.json && node test/compare.mjs /tmp/readback-js.json /tmp/readback-py.json
